title: Databricks Apps will soon be turned on for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
body:
Starting in early September 2026, [Databricks Apps](/aws/en/dev-tools/databricks-apps) will be automatically on for workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled.

See [Databricks Apps](/aws/en/dev-tools/databricks-apps).
